requirements.description: LEAKAGE CURRENTS that can flow in a FUNCTIONAL EARTH CONDUCTOR in a non-PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT are 5 mA in NORMAL CONDITION and 10 mA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION

semantic_fragments.content: Leakage currents that can flow in a FUNCTIONAL EARTH CONDUCTOR in a non-PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT are limited to 5 mA in NORMAL CONDITION and 10 mA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION per IEC60601-1 clause 8.7(f). This requirement was marked N/A for this product.

Insulation forming MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION and complying with IEC 60950-1 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION was determined not applicable (no such insulation identified). No components with insulation exempted from test per clause 4.8 were identified. No spirally wrapped insulation is present in this product.

For Annex L spirally wrapped insulation with CREEPAGE DISTANCES between layers less than in Table 12 or 16 (Pollution Degree 1), the path between layers must be sealed as a cemented joint per 8.9.3.3, and test voltages of TYPE TESTS in L.3 must equal 1.6 times of normal values. This clause was marked N/A as no spirally wrapped insulation is present.

Resistance to heat requirements per 8.8.4.1: All insulation and insulating partition walls must retain resistance to heat during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of ME EQUIPMENT. Compliance verified via: ME EQUIPMENT and design documentation examination (RM Results), RISK MANAGEMENT FILE examination in conjunction with resistance to moisture, dielectric strength, and mechanical strength tests, ball pressure test conducted using Fig 21 apparatus per clause 8.8.4.1(a) for ENCLOSURE and external parts of insulating material (excluding flexible cords and ceramic material).
